Back to Karmbhoomi. Back to the grind. ⚖️

After a refreshing break, back to the Supreme Court of India—where every day brings new challenges, learning, and opportunities to serve the cause of justice.

The vacation was rejuvenating; now it is time to return with renewed energy, focus and determination.

Back to the courtroom. Back to the files. Back to the pursuit of justice. ⚖️
